$description: Component tokens: only values a project may need to tune per component.

height.$description: The page header's height, without the safe area it adds as the screen's top bar.

offset.$description: Where the page header sticks: 0, or an app bar's height when the page header sits under one.

row-height.$description: A body row's height in the table layout, from 768 px up (44px).

height.$description: The list row's minimum height; a row with a description grows past it.
The list header's height (44px), a list row's, so the bar and the rows under it line up.
The thickness of the meter's bar (8px).
A pill's height; on a touch screen it keeps a 40px hit area.

width.$description: A dialog's width; on a phone it is the screen's width less a margin, or the screen's as a bottom sheet.

side-width.$description: The width of a sheet on the start or end side (size md, the default), at most the screen's width less a gap.

side-width-lg.$description: The width of a large sheet (size lg) on the start or end side, at most the screen's width less a gap.

side-width-xl.$description: The width of a wide sheet (size xl), for a form in two columns, on the start or end side, at most the screen's width less a gap.

peek-height.$description: How much of a drawer shows at its peek snap point on a phone: the handle, the header and the top of the body.

space-before.$description: The space above a section heading that follows other content, so the page's sections stack evenly (40px).

space-after.$description: The space between a section heading and its section's content (16px).

text-min-width.$description: From 768px, the least width the heading's text keeps beside the actions (240px); past it the actions move under the text.

item-height.$description: An item's height (40px), its touch target too.

width.$description: The app nav's width as a sidebar, from 1280px (240px).

rail-width.$description: The app nav's width as a rail, from 768px to 1279px (56px): a 40px item, the room around it and the divider.

height.$description: The app bar's height (56px), the page header's and the app nav brand's, so the three line up.

search-width.$description: The most width of the app bar's search button (320px); it narrows with the bar.

secondary-width.$description: The split view's secondary column (folders), from 1280px (240px).

list-width.$description: The split view's list beside the detail, from 768px (320px).

min-width.$description: A menu's least width (192px); it grows with its longest item.

max-width.$description: A menu's most width (320px), and never more than the screen less a margin.

height.$description: The toolbar's height (44px), a list header's.

search-width.$description: The most width of the toolbar's search field with its scope (320px); it narrows with the toolbar.

search-min-width.$description: The least width of the toolbar's search field with its scope (160px); past it, the target is cut short.

trailing-size.$description: The room a text field keeps at its end for its trailing slot (32px): a small icon button or a short keyboard hint. A project with a wider hint raises it.

width.$description: The width of a switch's track (32px).

height.$description: The height of a switch's track (20px); the thumb sits inside it, a little smaller.

group-gap.$description: The space between a nav list's groups (24px), so each heading starts a block of its own.

heading-font-family.$description: A group heading's face; a brand may pick a condensed label face.

heading-font-size.$description: A group heading's size (12px), a step under the items'.

heading-tracking.$description: A group heading's letter spacing, opened up for its uppercase letters.

heading-color.$description: A group heading's colour, a step quieter than the items'.
